name: /update-views Telegram command + daily-digest hint update
block: Phase 1.5 gate ops — manual posting workflow polish
goal: Two deliverables: (1) /update-views <video_id> <views> Telegram command — rewrites views on an existing manual-posts.jsonl entry (for when operator returns after 24h with real view count). Owner-only. Returns updated gate progress. (2) Update daily-digest.ts tip line to mention /review and /record Telegram commands instead of CLI. Full Telegram UX now surfaced in daily morning push.
rationale: Apr 7 gate: ~22 days, 0/30 posts. /record (Sprint 143) records initial views (often 0 at posting time). Operator needs /update-views 24h later with real count. daily-digest hint still points to CLI — operator won't know /review + /record exist from the morning digest.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 file edits + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — handleUpdateViews() + update handleHelp()
tasks.description: Add handleUpdateViews(chatId, ownerChatId, text): owner-only. Parse '/update-views <video_id> <views>'. video_id = args[1], views = parseInt(args[2]). Validate: missing args → show usage. NaN views → show usage. Load all lines from manual-posts.jsonl. Find entry where video_id matches. If not found: '⚠️ video_id not found in manual-posts.jsonl'. If found: update the views field. Rewrite entire file (writeFileSync). Compute gate progress (same as handleRecord). Send: '✅ Updated: <video_id> views → <new_views>' + gate progress block. Add '/update-views <id> <views> — Update view count on recorded post (owner)' to handleHelp() under TikTok Pipeline section.

tasks.title: index.ts — route /update-views to handleUpdateViews()
tasks.description: Import handleUpdateViews from ./commands. Add case '/update-views': await handleUpdateViews(chatId, OWNER_CHAT_ID, text); in dispatch switch after /record case.

tasks.title: daily-digest.ts — update tip line to mention /review + /record
tasks.description: Line ~159: change 'Review videos: `npx ts-node scripts/scs001/review-videos.ts`' to '💡 _Telegram: /review to pick video, /record <id> <views> to track_'. Also update the no-pipeline fallback line to include /review tip. Keeps the operator informed of new workflow from morning push.

tasks.title: scripts/scs001/validate-sprint-144.ts — validation script
tasks.description: 7 checks: (1) commands.ts exports handleUpdateViews; (2) handleUpdateViews is owner-gated; (3) handleUpdateViews uses writeFileSync (rewrites file); (4) handleHelp lists /update-views; (5) index.ts imports handleUpdateViews; (6) index.ts routes '/update-views'; (7) daily-digest.ts contains '/review' mention. Exit 0 on all pass.

/update-views <id> <views> rewrites views in manual-posts.jsonl and returns gate progress
